notes.title: Beacon's Bluff 1.04 Update Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43679181/852c75f730069f5cfdc64deda5dccfc39b193622.gif[/img]
We've released Beacon's Bluff 1.04 Update for Windows and Mac OS!

This update fixes a crash bug experienced by some Windows users on certain graphics cards near the end game.  

It also includes the following improvements:
[list]
[*] More gameplay balancing and tuning.
[*] Significantly improved cutscene animations.
[*] Other minor bug fixes
[/list]
The lighthouse needs keepers.  Get to it!

tags.bug: This update fixes a crash bug experienced by some Windows users on certain graphics cards near the end game.

notes.title: Beacon's Bluff 1.03 Update Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43679181/bea116a128cf11c4eea06a48fe039753031611b3.gif[/img]
We've released Beacon's Bluff 1.03 Update for Windows and Mac OS!

This update includes the following improvements:
[list]
[*] Gameplay balancing based on user feedback.
[*] Improved cutscene animations.
[*] Fixes to a number of small bugs, including fades and game ending progression.
[*] Fixed a crash bug on retrying after death.
[/list]
Keep the light burning.  Always!

notes.title: Stove Puzzle
notes.content:
[h1]First look at new puzzle[/h1]

[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/bs20malKYHkuLEDCYD/giphy.gif[/img]

A rickety old stove sits in the shadows, its mouth agape, hungry for firewood. But, this fire-breathing beast is picky - the logs must be arranged in a very particular order (randomized each time). Watch closely. The ghostly whispers in the wind carry hints. Can you remember the order amidst the howls?

Beacon's Bluff launches later this month!
